name: boxescape
displayName: BoxEscape: Dev Container and Agent Sandbox Escape Checker
description: Finds the settings that hand your host to an AI coding agent running "safely" in a dev container or Docker sandbox: --privileged, a mounted docker.sock, host network or PID, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, seccomp=unconfined, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws or $HOME mounted in, forwarded SSH agents, a firewall script that never runs. Checks devcontainer.json, Docker Compose and docker run lines that launch Claude Code, Codex and other agent CLIs. Quick Fixes, fully offline.

virtualWorkspaces.description: BoxEscape reads container configuration files from local disk.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder with a dev container, a Docker Compose file or scripts that start an AI agent in Docker, and BoxEscape checks how much of your host the container can reach.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

No container escape found.
BoxEscape checks devcontainer.json, Docker Compose services and docker run lines that launch agent CLIs for --privileged, a shared Docker socket, host network / PID / IPC, dangerous capabilities, seccomp or AppArmor turned off, host credentials and $HOME mounted in, forwarded SSH / GPG agents, host devices and agent firewall scripts that never run.
[Rescan Workspace](command:boxEscape.rescan)

boxEscape.enabled.description: Check dev container, Docker Compose and agent docker run settings for ways out to the host.

BE002.description: Host Docker socket shared with the container.

BE003.description: Host network, PID, IPC or user namespace.

BE005.description: seccomp, AppArmor or SELinux confinement turned off.

BE006.description: Host credentials, $HOME or a host system path mounted.

BE008.description: SSH or GPG agent socket forwarded.

BE010.description: Agent egress firewall missing, not run or ignored.

BE011.description: AI agent container runs as root.

boxEscape.rules.markdownDescription: Severity per rule, or `off`, e.g. `{ "BE007": "off", "BE003": "error" }`. When a rule is not set here, its severity depends on the finding: BE002, BE006 and BE008 are errors in containers that run an AI agent and warnings otherwise.

boxEscape.extraAgentPatterns.markdownDescription: Extra regular expressions (case-insensitive, at most 200 characters each, 20 patterns) that mark a container as running an AI agent when they match its name, image, command, lifecycle commands or Dockerfile, e.g. `my-agent-cli`. Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenCode, OpenHands, Cline, Cursor Agent and Gemini CLI are recognised already. In an untrusted workspace only your user setting is used.

boxEscape.checkScripts.description: Also check docker run / podman run lines in shell scripts (*.sh, *.bash) that launch an AI agent CLI.

boxEscape.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files scanned in the workspace (open files are always checked). Files over 1 MB are skipped.

boxEscape.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns (workspace-relative) that are never scanned. `node_modules`, `.git`, `vendor`, `venv` and `.venv` are always excluded. In an untrusted workspace only your user setting is used.
